fullDescription: An EDITORIAL MAGAZINE PITCH-DECK SYSTEM (16:9) built as repeatable layouts, not one slide. Off-white #f1ece1 ground, ONE brick-red #b3401f accent, and a low film-grain overlay on every slide. The signature is one ENORMOUS Anton condensed word (Oswald/Archivo-Narrow fallback) as the cover hero, packed tight (line-height ~.8) so the type fills the frame, plus TRACKED-CAPS editorial furniture (label left / year right) pinned to the top margin that REPEATS on every content slide as the through-line. Layouts: COVER (giant word-stack + byline), CONTENT/STAT (a huge Anton number over a short editorial line), and a SECTION BREAK that inverts to a solid brick-red ground with a Playfair Display serif for the register shift. Reusable for pitch decks, quarterly/brand reviews, magazine-style report covers, and lookbooks.

structured.summary: An EDITORIAL MAGAZINE PITCH-DECK SYSTEM at 16:9 (1600x900 slides), designed as a set of REPEATABLE layouts that read as one magazine, not three unrelated templates. GROUND: off-white / warm cream #f1ece1 on content slides, with a subtle FILM-GRAIN overlay (~6% opacity, SVG feTurbulence) on every slide for a printed-paper feel. COLOR: strictly off-white + near-black ink #1c1913 + ONE brick-red accent #b3401f (a slightly warmer #a2451f is acceptable for the small furniture caps). No second color, no photos, no gradient decoration. TYPE SYSTEM: the hero is ANTON (a tall CONDENSED grotesque, loaded from Google Fonts; fall back to Oswald / Archivo Narrow / Bebas Neue, NEVER a normal-width sans) set ALL-CAPS in brick-red at massive scale (~340-360px on the cover) with tight leading (line-height ~.8) so a 1-2 word stack fills the lower two-thirds; body/editorial lines are a clean sans (Public Sans) in a muted ink; the SECTION BREAK shifts register to PLAYFAIR DISPLAY serif. FURNITURE (the through-line): tracked ALL-CAPS labels (~.2em tracking, weight 700, brick-red) pinned to the TOP margin — a wordmark/section label at top-left and a year or slide-number at top-right — REPEAT in the same position on every content slide; a mono slide-label sits bottom-right. THREE LAYOUTS: (1) COVER = top furniture + one enormous Anton word-stack anchored to the bottom + a tracked-caps byline on the baseline; (2) CONTENT/STAT = same top furniture + a giant Anton number/stat + a short editorial sentence beneath at ~50px in muted ink (max-width ~70%); (3) SECTION BREAK = invert to a SOLID brick-red ground with cream text, a small Anton section number top-left, and a large Playfair Display serif headline centered — the one slide that changes register so the deck breathes. Invent generic copy (e.g. 'SHIP / WEEKLY', 'SUPERDESIGN · 2026') — never a template brand.

style.description: Editorial magazine-cover-as-slide: the type IS the image and the FURNITURE is the brand. A warm off-white #f1ece1 ground under a faint film-grain gives a printed-paper feel; the whole deck is off-white + near-black ink + ONE brick-red accent, no photos and no second color. The signature is one enormous tall-CONDENSED grotesque (Anton) set all-caps in brick-red at poster scale with tight leading, so a one- or two-word hero fills most of the slide. Tracked all-caps labels pinned to the top corners repeat on every slide and are what make the set read as one designed magazine. A single Playfair Display section break, on an inverted solid brick-red ground, is the deliberate register shift that keeps a condensed-sans deck from feeling monotone. Loud, editorial, restrained to one accent, and coherent because the furniture never moves.

layout_and_structure.description: A 16:9 deck of three repeatable layouts sharing one grid: a top-margin furniture row (label left / year or number right) and a mono slide-label bottom-right on every slide. COVER: furniture on top, one enormous Anton all-caps word-stack anchored to the bottom, a tracked-caps byline on the baseline. CONTENT/STAT: same furniture, a giant Anton number/stat, and a short editorial sentence beneath in muted ink (max-width ~70%). SECTION BREAK: the palette inverts to a solid brick-red ground with cream text, a small Anton section number top-left, and a large Playfair Display serif headline centered. The furniture position is constant across all slides so the system reads as one magazine.

prompts.prompt: Fill each slide with warm off-white #f1ece1 and lay a faint film-grain overlay (~6% opacity, SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise) over it. Pin a tracked ALL-CAPS furniture row to the TOP margin on every content slide: a wordmark/section label at top-left and a year or slide-number at top-right, both weight 700, ~.2em tracking, brick-red #b3401f (or the warmer #a2451f). Add a small monospace slide-label ('01 / cover') bottom-right at ~50% opacity. This furniture is the through-line — keep its position identical on every slide.

On the cover, set a 1-2 word hero in Anton (tall CONDENSED grotesque; Oswald/Archivo-Narrow/Bebas fallback, never a normal-width sans), ALL CAPS, brick-red #b3401f, ~340-360px with line-height ~.8, left-aligned and anchored to the bottom so the stack fills the lower two-thirds ('SHIP / WEEKLY'). Beneath it on the baseline, a tracked ALL-CAPS byline in near-black ink ('PRESENTED BY J. ZHOU · Q3 REVIEW').

Keep the top furniture, then center a giant Anton stat/number in brick-red at large scale (a huge '3.4x' feel, line-height ~.78), with a single short editorial sentence beneath in a clean muted-ink sans (Public Sans) at ~50px, max-width ~70%. One idea per slide; the number carries the slide.

For a section break, INVERT the palette: a solid brick-red #b3401f ground with cream #f1ece1 text. Put a small Anton section number top-left, and center a large PLAYFAIR DISPLAY serif headline (weight 700, line-height ~.98). This is the one slide that changes typeface and ground, so it lets a condensed-sans deck breathe — use it sparingly (section dividers only).

special_ui_components.description: One or two all-caps words in a tall condensed grotesque, brick-red, packed tight so the type fills the slide.
special_ui_components.prompt: Set a 1-2 word hero in Anton (tall CONDENSED grotesque; Oswald/Archivo-Narrow/Bebas fallback, never a normal-width sans), ALL CAPS, brick-red #b3401f, ~340-360px with line-height ~.8, left-aligned and bottom-anchored so it fills the lower two-thirds. The condensed width is the look — protect it through any font substitution; a normal-width sans leaves gaps and kills it.

special_ui_components.description: The top-margin label/year row (plus a mono slide-label) that repeats in the same position on every slide and makes the deck read as one magazine.
special_ui_components.prompt: Pin a tracked ALL-CAPS row to the top margin on every slide: a wordmark/section label top-left, a year or slide-number top-right, weight 700, ~.2em tracking, brick-red. Add a small monospace slide-label bottom-right at ~50% opacity. Never move these positions between slides — the constant furniture is the system's through-line.

special_ui_components.description: An inverted solid brick-red slide with a Playfair Display serif headline — the deliberate change of typeface and ground that punctuates the deck.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build a section-divider slide that inverts to a solid brick-red #b3401f ground with cream text, a small Anton section number top-left, and a large Playfair Display serif headline (weight 700) centered. Use it only for section transitions so the shift stays meaningful and the condensed-sans body never feels monotone.

special_ui_components.description: Off-white ground + near-black ink + ONE brick-red accent, unified by a faint grain overlay on every slide.

Lay a faint film-grain overlay (~6%, SVG feTurbulence) over every slide so the deck reads as printed paper and all layouts share one surface.
